svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Global infant mortality by cause for boys vs. girls 2023
Infant mortality rates are the number of deaths of infants under one year old, measured per 100,000. This is
shown globally for different causes of death in infant boys versus girls. Causes which lie above the grey line
have higher mortality rates in boys relative to girls.
Infant mortality rate for girls (per 100,000) (deaths per 100,000 people; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Infant mortality rate for boys (per 100,000) (deaths per 100,000 people; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
